message.reasoning: We have a pager alert: inventory p95 latency above 800ms. Health check shows inventory unhealthy. Logs show slow GC pause and waiting for DB connections: waited 1052ms, 2946ms, 2993ms. Config changes: inventory db_pool_size changed from 20 to 2 at 04:20. That's likely cause. We set back to 20. After setting config, health check healthy. So root cause: bad config change reducing DB pool size. Smallest safe change: revert db_pool_size to 20. Completed. Now finish.

function.name: finish
function.arguments: {"cause":"bad_config","root_cause_service":"inventory","summary":"The inventory service experienced high latency due to an accidental configuration change that reduced the database connection pool size from 20 to 2. This caused connection waits and elevated request times. The issue was resolved by restoring the pool size to 20, after which the service returned to healthy status."}
